title: Split peas, dried, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Split peas are dried pea seeds that have been cut in half. They contain no added fat and are a rich source of plant protein, complex carbohydrates, and dietary fiber. Split peas are commonly used in soups, purees, and as a side dish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Split peas cook faster than whole peas because of their halved shape.
They are a staple in many cuisines, such as Indian dal, British pea soup, and Russian shchi.
Dried split peas have a long shelf life when stored in a cool, dry place.
Peas are high in iron, making them useful for preventing anemia.
Compared with whole peas, split peas produce a smoother texture when cooked.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: One cup of cooked split peas provides about 16 g of protein, supporting tissue growth and repair.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Complex carbohydrates give sustained energy and a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B6, and folate are involved in metabolism and support the nervous system.

items.title: Minerals: iron, magnesium, phosphorus
items.content: These minerals are important for blood formation, bone health, and muscle function.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: Anti‑nutrient content
items.content: Raw peas contain phytic acid and lectins that can reduce mineral absorption; they should be fully cooked.

items.title: Gas formation
items.content: High fiber content may cause bloating or flatulence in sensitive people.

items.title: Not suitable for certain kidney conditions
items.content: The relatively high purine content can increase kidney load in people with gout.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook split peas for 20‑30 minutes until tender, then use them in soups, purees, salads, or as a side. They can be added to vegetable stews or processed into a vegetarian mince.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dried split peas in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. Properly stored, they keep for 2‑3 years.
